items.title: Maruti, Tata lead hatchback revival as India's carmakers rediscover the mass market
items.summary: Indian carmakers are rediscovering the hatchback. For years, SUVs dominated sales. Now, rising prices and economic challenges mean small cars are key for growth. Companies like Maruti Suzuki and Tata Motors are investing in new, feature-rich hatchbacks. This strategy aims to attract first-time buyers and expand the market.

items.title: Electric PV sales in fast lane in May with 81% growth: FADA
items.summary: Penetration rises to record 6.6% during the month. Tata Motors retained its leadership position, followed by Mahindra & Mahindra and JSW MG Motor India.

items.title: Renault electric vehicle orders have surged since start of Iran war: CEO
items.summary: Batteries often make up to half the cost of an EV, so switching to LFP batteries would enable Renault to sell more affordable electric cars to consumers.

items.title: Mahindra's SUV output dips up to 15% in June amid supply chain worker crunch; XUV 7XO, Thar production hit
items.summary: The automotive industry across India faces similar labor challenges. Companies are adapting through automation and worker retention strategies. Demand for new vehicles remains strong, compounding these production pressures.

items.title: Renault EV orders have surged in Europe since Iran war began, says CEO
items.summary: Renault sees a 50 percent jump in electric vehicle orders in France and Germany since the Iran war began. The carmaker is boosting production to meet this demand. Renault is also exploring cheaper battery options to make EVs more affordable. The company is not looking to partner with other automakers for production space.

items.title: Mercedes launches mass production of electric motor for high-performance AMG brand
items.summary: Mercedes-Benz has begun series production of a new lightweight axial flux electric motor at its Berlin-Marienfelde plant. This innovative technology, designed to be lighter and more efficient than traditional motors, aims to address the challenges of electrifying high-performance AMG vehicles.

items.title: Tyre Makers Walk Tightrope In FY27 As Demand Holds Firm, But Costs Surge
items.summary: India’s tyre makers are entering FY27 with strong demand visibility, high plant utilisation and a fresh capex cycle. But they are also facing one of the sharpest input cost shocks in recent quarters, triggered by the West Asia crisis, crude-linked raw material volatility, higher natural rubber prices, rupee depreciation and rising logistics costs.

items.title: TVS Srichakra Approves Rs 220 Crore Capex for Capacity Expansion at Madurai Plants
items.summary: The board of directors of TVS Srichakra Limited has approved a capital investment of up to Rs 220 crore to expand production capacities at its manufacturing facilities located in Vellaripatti, Madurai. The decision was finalized during a board meeting on May 27, 2026, according to a regulatory filing submitted to the stock exchanges.

items.title: Govt set to roll out ₹3,000-crore incentive scheme for lithium, nickel processing to boost EV supply chain
items.summary: To qualify for the proposed incentives, lithium processing facilities are expected to require a minimum annual capacity of 30,000 metric tonnes, while nickel processing plants would need a minimum capacity of 50,000 metric tonnes.

items.title: PMO to examine battery PLI scheme amid SEBI allegations on Rajesh Exports
items.summary: In its interim order, SEBI has alleged that ACC Energy Storage Pvt Ltd was set up in 2022 as a wholly owned subsidiary of Rajesh Exports Limited and was used as a vehicle for non-transparent related-party transactions and the diversion of company funds.

items.title: Clean rules put auto parts cos on a whole new growth path
items.summary: Even as geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions create near-term volatility, industry executives said the regulatory cycle—spanning fuel efficiency, emissions, safety and electrification—is broader than earlier ones and is expected to increase the value of components fitted in every vehicle.
